en: Dude, can you not? What do you think about Haruka Sawamura?
Meh, she ain't got the same air of danger. Not my type.
Who do ya think'll win the Princess League?
T-Set, of course. Their dancin' and singin' are on point.
I dunno. I think Haruka Sawamura might come through with a miracle. She made it this far, after all.
Not a chance. T-Set are one hundred percent cuter.
No way! You're just super into that bad girl image of theirs. Next thing you'll be tellin' me is you're into whips and chains and all that crap.
I mean... I am.
...Well, shit.
What's the deal with all those kids ya see dancin' around town these days?
Haven't ya heard? It's street dancin'! Urban contemporary youth culture, ya know?
No kiddin'?
Dance battles, huh? Honestly, sounds like it could be fun.
Then give it a go. Nothin' to be afraid of.
What if everyone thinks I suck, though? I dunno if I wanna go through that.
Don't be silly! With that attitude, you're never gonna get any better! I'm already participatin' in them, you know.
What? Seriously!? Ya gotta take me with you, bro! Don't leave me hangin'!
Man, now they've had an attempted murder.
What the hell's wrong with that agency? They gotta be cursed or somethin'. Stay far away from those guys, man.
The company's probably gonna go under. Looks pretty grim, anyway.
Some chick jumped off a rooftop nearby. Awful stuff.
She was president of a talent agency, right? I bet that's the end of that agency.
Maybe not right away, but it'll definitely affect their rep around town. Could drive 'em outta business if they ain't careful.
What're they up to at that agency now? All this racket's making it hard to get some sleep.
Didn't you hear? Some girl fell off the roof. People are saying she was pushed. Scary, huh?
Ain't none of my concern. I just wish they'd keep a lid on it at night.
Those damn police cars kept me up all night with their stupid sirens.
The president of the company in the building over there jumped off the roof and killed herself. What a pain in the ass.
That woman ya always see walkin' around? Hard to think she'd commit suicide. She looked like she had her shit together...
What's up? You're looking pretty glum.
Ya heard about that suicide this mornin'? I go past there on my way to work every day.
There was a girl 'bout my daughter's age there lookin' completely distraught. Might've been the daughter of the lady who killed herself.
Couldn't bear to think of my girl havin' to go through somethin' like that.
It's all one big conspiracy, I'm sure of it.
What is?
You heard about how the president of Haruka Sawamura's agency killed herself, right? Now one of their employees almost got killed, too!
No shit? That's fucked up.
How can ya be so calm about this!? It's gotta be a conspiracy. Someone in T-Set's camp must've set it up to keep Haruka Sawamura from winnin'!
Yeah, you really think so? Huh.
Drinkin' up a storm at a noisy bar is fun, but today I just feel like a nice, quiet drink.
Oh, come on. You know I can't hold my liquor, Senpai.
Bars around here... I guess Crest Bar would be best. It's a bit more sophisticated.
The last train is leaving soon... Can I just go home?
Word is, the president of T-Set's agency used to be some hotshot actor. Saw him on TV a while back. He looked pretty decent, no lie.
I've got good instincts when it comes to older guys. He's gotta be ripped. Bet it would feel amazing to be wrapped up in those beefy arms...
You really got a thing for older men, huh? I prefer younger girls, fresh as the buddin' cherry blossoms waitin' for spring.
Uh... Okay?
If T-Set wins the Princess League and makes their major debut, I bet their agency is gonna rake in the cash.
'Course they will. It gets their name out. Everyone'll be callin' up to hire 'em.
Guess that'd make ya wanna win at any cost, if ya know what I mean...
I see what you're gettin' at. It's possible. We'll have to keep an eye on Osaka Talent.
That place is dicey. Gotta be somethin' goin' on there.
Whaddya talkin' about?
The waste disposal place near where I live. It's fishy as all hell.
Yeah, but why?
All those scary guys goin' in and out of there! I bet you my left nut they're yakuza!
Should be fine if ya stay away from 'em, right? They ain't gonna bite as long as ya steer clear.
Yeah, I guess not.
I've had enough. I'm gonna have to move.
What's the big rush? You just moved here, didn't you?
Yeah, but this something-or-other Enterprises place nearby is always makin' a racket, and the smell comin' out is horrible. I can't live here anymore.
That's too bad. Maybe you could complain to the city office.
Yeah, but what're they gonna do...
It was Haruka-chan back there, I'm tellin' ya!
No way. What would she be doin' here?
Excuse me. Did you really see Haruka Sawamura around here?
Yeah. She mighta been lookin' for a taxi. She was headed that way, runnin' like the wind.
Hey, maybe she was shootin' an episode of Running Girl!
Some clients, huh? Callin' me to Tokyo on such short notice. I'll never get a plane ticket, so I guess I'll have to take a train.
Then we'd better hurry to Shin-Osaka Station. A cab can get us there in no time.
Hey, Shinada.
Oh, hi.
Hoo, boy. You sure got that week-before-payday air about you. Well, here's a stroke of good fortune for you. Here, take one of these.
You got <Color:8>Prize Tickets<Color:Default>.
A prize ticket?
Yup. It's a part of the local community things that the Chamber of Commerce is doing.
You're supposed to get some for shopping or dining locally. But get this, a bunch got blown away by a gust of wind. Now, you can find 'em all over town.
We spent quite a bit to round up some decent prizes. Try your luck at the prize wheel⑬it has to take a turn for the better sometime.
A prize wheel, huh? Can't say no to something that comes free. I'll be happy to partake in your generosity.
Yeah, you give it a go. And work harder, too.
All I've been hearing lately is Nagoya Family this, Nagoya Family that. Wonder what they're actually like?
Well, they're yakuza, and they run this town, right? Bound to be a scary bunch.
Yeah. The other day, I heard some poor guy got both eyes gouged out for not paying his debt.
Seriously? That's terrible.
Which place should I pick today? Dainagon? Maybe Strawberry?
Club Futo Momo... Yeah, Milky-chan's place! It's settled!
Did you hear that Milky at Club Futo Momo is over forty?
Wow, that's something. Does that place cater to guys who like mature women or something?
No, not really. She must have some awesome skills.
I'm really out of shape right now. Know a good place to get a workout?
The batting center's the closest place. It's at the north end of Tsumugi Street. Wanna go?
A batting center! Man, I haven't been to one of those in years. Let's go hit a few balls!
Damn it! I've had it! These clients think they can get away with anything!
Calm down. We could go for a drink, but I think you'd be better off going down to the batting center. Take out your frustrations on a couple balls.
Oh, yeah. The place on Tsumugi Street, right? Okay, I can pretend I'm whacking his stupid face!
What the hell was that, Ta-kun? You missed every ball. What a loser.
It's the lights, I'm telling you. They're way too bright! How the hell am I supposed to see the ball!?
Oh, please. They're not that bright at all. Guess you've got that in common with them.
You don't get it. It's impossible. They make it so you can't hit a home run on purpose!
That does it. I can't take any more of your bullshit excuses. You're embarrassing me.
I'm looking for work in Kineicho. Know anyone who might be hiring?
Hmm, how about you go and see Ushijima-san? He's got connections all over town.
Yeah? That sounds like a good call. Where can I find him?
He runs the Ushijima Dining Bar, over on Kumano Boulevard. Want me to show you where it is?
What a strange-looking guy that was. Wearing a hat and mask, with sunglasses to boot? You think he's some kind of escaped fugitive or something?
Dunno. He sure was parading around all cocky, though. Like he wasn't afraid of someone catching him or something.
That only makes it weirder.
Oh, hey, Shinada-san.
Hi. What's up?
Have you heard about this suspicious-looking guy going around in a hat, mask, and sunglasses?
Yeah, Ushijima-san mentioned him to me.
He came past here just now. I was going to do my spiel on him, but there was just something about him... I couldn't even open my mouth to speak.
Huh. Wonder what he's doing around here dressed like that.
I know that Kineicho is Nagoya Family turf, but I've never seen them around.
Well, with the law cracking down on them these days, I guess they're keeping a low profile.
Makes sense. Running things from behind the scenes, probably. That way you never know where the Nagoya Family could be watching.
That old bitch was grinning to herself when I couldn't hit those balls.
Yeah, she's a real cow. I bet having her working there scares away customers, too.
Screw her! I'll get that old hag back one day!
Man, my shoulders are stiff, and my back is killing me. I can't get any work done.
How about trying acupuncture? I go to the Uno Acupuncture Clinic on Obiita Street.
Yeah? Is it any good?
He's definitely got the touch. My whole body feels lighter. That said...
What? Something wrong with the place?
Nah, but it always seems to be closed. Rumor is he likes his massages, especially the ones that come with a happy ending. He's a great acupuncturist, though!
That Uno Acupuncture Clinic needs to get shut down like, yesterday! I am never going there again!
Huh? What happened?
The old guy who runs the place is a total creep. He totally copped a feel when he was working on me! I should have him arrested!
You sure that wasn't just part of the massage?
Oh, that was no massage. It was full-on groping! You'd better stay away from that horrible place!
Hey, did you hear the racket coming from inside that place? It sounded like a fight.
You sure? I didn't hear anything.
You didn't? Maybe I'm just hearin' things...
Huh. Ushijima-san's place is closed today. I guess I'll have to find somewhere else to eat.
Dang it! Of course Milky-chan's out sick. Just when I was looking forward to seeing her.
That gave me a scare. What were those guys up to? Security guards, maybe? They all looked built as hell. Where were they all headed?
I think I'll go fishing at the Port of Nagoya.
Good idea. It's a pretty quick trip by taxi. Just make sure you don't get yourself lost.
The port's filled with containers, so it's easy to lose your bearings. You wouldn't want to get lost on the way back and ruin your nice catch.
Whoa. Maybe I'll pass after all.
Let's go to Kamurocho Hills! An overseas brand just opened their first Japanese store there.
Aren't all the stores there hideously expensive? Let's leave it for another day.
We're going! We're going to Kamurocho Hills!
Uh, okay...?
I hear that Shin-Kamuro Hills Hotel has rooms that cost hundreds of thousands of yen a night.
Wow.
It must be amazing to look out over the city at night from the top of Kamurocho Hills, sipping champagne...
Never mind that. Seaweed is on sale at the market today! We'd better hurry! There's a limit of two packs per customer!
The sixth chairman of the Tojo Clan is missing, his top man Majima got killed, and a captain candidate, Saejima, just broke out of jail.
The Tojo Clan is done for. At this rate, they'll be taken over by the Omi Alliance in no time.
Haven't heard anything about the Majima Family since their patriarch got killed.
They're pretty militant, so I figured they'd go after the Omi for revenge even without proof they did it.
Yeah. They still have an office up in Millennium Tower. I wonder what's going on.
Well, I guess when a group loses a leader as charismatic as that, they're going to hurt for a while. Bet there's gonna be a big power shift within the Tojo Clan.
That Mama who runs the New Serena is a stunner. But she's pretty guarded, and there always seems to be this eagle-eyed dude hanging around, staring at people.
That's because he's a detective, idiot. He's in homicide.
Seriously!? So she's taken, then? I mean, I do like me a good challenge...
Better quit while you're ahead.
Remember that old urban legend about the place called Purgatory under this city?
